newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates drop to end at 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates drop to end at 21 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates dropped 1.375 points on Friday as liquidity rose as expected, traders said.
"There were no bids in early trade as everybody was expecting the rates to go lower," said Istvan Horvath, of Hyop-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates closed at 21 percent, compared with Thursday's close of 22.375 percent, and the bulk of Friday morning's deals concluded between 21.00 and 21.50 percent.
Maturing government bonds were behind the abundant liquidity as probably tens of billions of forints hit the market.
Horvath said he does not expect the rates to go lower on Monday as the tax-payment deadline of April 20 will have its impact on Monday, soaking up some of the excess funds.
